title: The Fourth Figure

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The basket has heard four figures and holds none of them. The road carries the slate up and comes back without a word on it. A number said four times is four numbers; the cleanest part of the slate is the space where the signature would stand.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Low Kiln bucket-round, in the month of Silt

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and thirty-two to four hundred and thirty-four days, six months and two hundred and fifty-two to two hundred and fifty-four days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 431 exact at the opening on answer 438, closing at 434 exact on answer 444. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the Drawing a room seen and not entered, the out-of-line landing a report brought up the yard and never a sighting. Silt 8 and 9 are two ordinary tending days, each with its own dated \daymark and two full scenes of at least eight hundred words, with no market, no Cross, no bell, no Account-day, no called collector and no runner; Silt 10, the month's first Account-day and market, is earned by its own morning and is the fourth reading of Y.H. 814. Nothing from the reported second slate of Silt 6 or the hair-thin thaw of Silt 7 crosses under the roof on any of the three days as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and neither is repeated, made a custom or brought under the roof; the account-day is not made to answer the neighbour's near-reaching at the shelf. The house takes up its grammar as though nothing had turned. Sella keeps the whole hearth grammar at both ends of every day and the widow's mark stays untouched; seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule, and an Account-day does not make an eighth due. On Silt 10 Berr Clay reads *one in twelve, as the notice says* twice over the basket for the first time in Silt and the fourth time in the year, calls the levy, denies it with *your house*, never *I*, sends a number from fist to mouth to shoulder into a slate at the watch and goes off up the clay road with the box locked and the fourth subtraction inside, believing he has done a kindness. **Four readings of the year now stand behind one unsigned figure** — four are four and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of four — and neither the twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 nor the first three readings of Y.H. 814 are laid across the fourth to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer. Sella sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade and stands half a pace off through the reading and the bell; Hessa carries the narrow slate edge-on and unread and is not made a reader by four figures; the soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the out-of-line landing with his entered figure brought up the yard as a report and not a sighting; the green and the shape stay sightings with no eighth, on separate trays. Six honest answers 439 through 444 stand on the sixth place, two to each day, and not one is a doctrine. Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside; nine record-first hands and nine stoppings stand with no tenth; the heard bell stands beside the told bell with both gaps in their own squares and three counts in three places staying three; the two market sightings of Ilmen 30 stay on separate trays with no eighth of either. Silt 20 (Day 444), the month's second reading, waits ten mornings beyond the close as a date and is not brought.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Eighth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first dated \daymark{432}{Silt 8, Y.H. 814, Eighthday}: the small hours open on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 438 and the count exact at 431, six months and two hundred and fifty-one days told by nobody, with no next hand in the room; the reported second slate of Silt 6 and the hair-thin thaw of Silt 7 stay each on a place of its own and are not told again or made a lesson on the morning after; then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning work of an ordinary Eighthday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects only (salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with its finer grey, the twice-mended pot, the unforged collector sentence). Ilva offstage with her count still in wood, Hessa's single slate unread up the road, Berr up the clay road with the box locked and the key gone up in a coat pocket; no market, Cross, bell, reading, runner or collector. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — one stiff brown-edged barley crust gone past leather into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put in the empty place and still a finding and not a placing, the thread stiff in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and could not ask for; the infant's three wants (crust lifted, thread wiped, a hand on the pot handle) quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work (T060/T086/T097). A detail of the horn-hard crust and the cold joint brings one untagged past-tense fragment of the surgeon's register, no present-tense break, no \memory{} tag (T004). Sella's whole hearth grammar holds at the morning: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, the small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, her finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand shut half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, repair held apart from restoration, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). Tarn keeps six pieces in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach; he tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count* once in the tone of a man stating the weather, found where put and not a habit, the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled in a term already ended and his valuable ear exposure and not safety (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and white in a fist-crease, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would call it early; *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062). Answer 439 comes out and is filed on the sixth place; count reaches 432 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-two days, told by nobody; he stands no number up as a threshold, doctrine or figure, for paper is not a payer (T071/T072).

scenes.title: What the Eighth Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Silt 8 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 440 filed and the count at 432 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-two days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only at the ordinary yard grammar; Ilva offstage with her strip in her sleeve and her ninth hand nine; Hessa's slate unread up the road, Berr's box locked up the road, the soft-cuffed clerk still reported at the out-of-line landing and never a sighting, a witness or a tenth hand. The offered figure and its return, the well-asking answered with the weather, the second man's turned slate and direction, the clerk's entered figure, the fifth shaping, the three likenesses of Slate Row, the neighbour's near-reaching of Silt 3, the reported second slate of Silt 6 and the hair-thin thaw of Silt 7 stay found where put and are not repeated on a day that earned only its eighth; the softer river edge and the finer thaw-grey are not made again, not made a sign, a fourth covering, a sixth shaping or a payer. No collector comes up or down the clay road and Silt 10 waits two mornings off as a date. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather — pail down on the flat stone with its flat knock, rope settling into its knot with the cold-stiffened rasp, barley wall to wall without a number, a loaf pushed a finger's width along a board and stopped with nobody calling the stopping a figure — and takes each apart by fist, eye, mouth and the half-beat in the gap, giving the gap no intention, for an intention wants a payer where none stands (T061/T082). He goes once around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest at the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back (T098, T009/T013/T092). The trough keeps the gone pan's shallow round print on a place of its own, not laid across the loaf's stopping or the ridge; at the Vail corner the two greys keep a finger between them, the called-gone beside the left-in-place, a thing left in place not forgiven, and the boy does not go around them a second time to make the Silt 7 finding a custom (T083/T085/T092 held). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry: a fist opens toward the well, looks at the light, shuts and goes back into a sleeve, arriving nowhere; a woman sent for a pot's cost is sent to the pot and gets a note and not a price; the figure read over the covered grain does not know what the grain cost and the ink-neat space between figure and price carries no signature (T077). Going of the light: Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, the whole grammar returns and the household straightens around the order; widow's mark untouched because a going of the light is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule; she tells the fire it is the thaw and does not tell the basket; the keeping at the fold found where put with no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer; under the boards the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer without a name for four hundred and thirty-two days; nobody lifts the floor and nobody supplies the pull (T058/T079, T097, T088). Small hours: the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments do when a case is done; the surgeon's exactness and the infant's want stand side by side, both true, the second louder, neither buying the other; answer 440 filed, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the reported second slate, the thaw, the neighbour's near-reaching nor any other kept thing (T061/T082, T071/T072). The hand comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go and comes down flat on the fold; there is no next hand in the room.

scenes.title: The Ninth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{433}{Silt 9, Y.H. 814, Ninthday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 440 and the count exact at 432, six months and two hundred and fifty-two days told by nobody; then first grey, the carrying-down and the morning of an ordinary Ninthday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar. No market, Cross, bell, Account-day, called collector or runner; nothing from Silt 8 crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. New day, new date, no recap. Dramatic purpose: the body is inventoried in the old order and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086/T097). The morning's honest work is given its exact texture — tallow and woodsmoke, wet wool, the pot board, the half-beat at the setting, the dressed grain turned under wool and covered, a fist of barley judged by the hand that carries it and set back without a number — and the surgeon reads the house by what it will not say rather than by what it will not survive; a warm room insisting a body is warm while the fingers go the colour of old rope is read past tense and untagged (T004). Sella's fire-before-basket grammar holds at the morning, ahead of the basket in every order; the widow's mark is untouched because a Ninthday morning is not an opening, and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079). Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach; *Six counted. The next I don't count* is found where put and not made a habit, not a tenth stopping, payment, hearing or rule; the ear-sentence stays stopped at the word that would call the loan, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his valuable ear exposure rather than safety in a term already ended (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through with grey slate dust ground meal-small past the bent finger, parts dusty from clean as clot from vessel, moves the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and takes the cold out of his fingertip without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; one bite of the iron holds and one takes, with no Grathic word covering both; the promise under the wheel-shed stays neither given nor withdrawn and *he's not Vail* stays sealed (T035/T031/T062). Answer 441 is filed; count reaches 433 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-three days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth is unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two counts standing side by side without becoming one (T071/T072, T088).

scenes.title: What the Ninth Left
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Silt 9 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 442 filed and the count at 433 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-three days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard well and rail: a woman at the bucket-round says a rope that holds is a rope that holds and another says the cold has got into the rope and will not come out before the thaw, and nobody owns the day; a woman sent to ask a pot's cost gets a note and not a price; a man waiting his turn opens a shut fist toward the water, looks at what is in it, shuts the fist and puts it back into a sleeve, the number arriving nowhere. Ilva, Hessa, Berr and the clerk are offstage with their keepings found where put; day already dated in Scene 3. Dramatic purpose: the yard keeps its arithmetic badly in loaves, glances and unnamed spaces while the boy keeps 433 exactly against it; the offered figure, the clerk's entered figure brought up the yard as a report, the second man's turned slate, the first man's patient face, the fifth shaping of the well-saying, the neighbour's near-reaching at the shelf, the reported second slate and the hair-thin thaw stay each on a place of its own with a finger between every pair and are not stood up as a rule, a witness, a tenth hand, a sixth shaping or a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T080/T090/T102, T097, T061/T082). The seven walked-around places go around once and not twice, widest at the returning-line place, the trough's round print stays on its own place, and the two greys at the corner keep their finger between, a thing left in place not a thing forgiven (T098, T009/T013/T092, T083/T085/T092 held). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry (T077). Tarn's sentence told to the wood is found where put and not made a second silence or a custom, a second silence being a custom and a third a way and both wanting a payer where none stands; the loan stays uncalled in a term already ended and his valuable ear stays exposure and not safety (T036/T076/T006). Jorra's bent finger leads at the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and comes away without a second holding of Ash 26; the two quiet men under one roof stay unjoined, neither a compact nor a cause, and the burned slate stands at five with the promise still neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062). Going of the light: Sella's whole grammar returns and closes the day, widow's mark hanging where it hangs, pot thumb-first with both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, grain covered and unfigured, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with its half-beat and no look toward the bed, the fold righted without a look at his face and with no second fold, the keeping found where put (T058/T079/T100, T060/T086/T097). Small hours: the towel comes out; answer 442 is filed exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; count 433 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-three days, told by nobody; the fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number (T071/T072, T088). Silt 10 (Day 434), the month's first Account-day and the year's fourth reading, waits one morning off as a date and is not brought into this day. The hand comes up an inch toward the river's note, holds the interval whole on the note's finishing, and comes down flat on the fold with no next hand in the room.

scenes.title: The Tenth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{434}{Silt 10, Y.H. 814, Tenthday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 442 and the count exact at 433, six months and two hundred and fifty-three days told by nobody; then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning of Silt's first Account-day and market, earned by its own morning and not made a threshold, a signing or an eighth opening. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Berr Clay up off the clay road, Hessa Rale going up the road before noon; Tarn and Jorra Vail offstage at kindling and wheel-shed with their keepings found where put; Garl Vail in objects. The soft-cuffed clerk stays reported at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge and is not a sighting, a witness, a tenth hand or a room entered; the green and the shape stay sightings on separate trays with no eighth and no name; nothing from Silt 6's report or Silt 7's thaw crosses under the roof as sign, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the reading is not made to answer the neighbour's near-reaching at the shelf. Dramatic purpose: **the chapter's one large change, advanced and NOT paid (T015/T041/T047).** Before first grey Sella sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lies and stands half a pace off, and the boy is carried to the Cross and set where the reading comes to him sideways and the basket is never looked into. Berr Clay comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat, the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, the smell of nothing at all under the hot clay of him, and large clean hands; he wipes his thumb twice before touching nothing — once for the slate and once for the figure that will be on it — holds a narrow slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, passes a finger over the figure through the cloth of his sleeve, lets his eyes rest on the writing a breath longer than the writing requires, and reads *One in twelve, as the notice says* low into the goers-by, twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late, never looking into it: the first reading in Silt and the fourth of the year. He calls the levy and denies it — *The levy is called. It is not called by me*; *Your house wants it again, there'll be a slate at the watch*; *If your household has heard otherwise, your household has heard wrong* — *your house*, never *I*, taking himself out of his own sentences as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on. To the man with the number in a shut fist he sends the number into a slate at the watch; it goes fist to mouth to shoulder and arrives nowhere. Something low he says to the block about kindness being entered, in the tone of a man setting a cup where a cup belongs, with no anger, no triumph and no payer standing; the stone answers nothing. He goes off up the clay road toward High Kiln with the cord folded, the narrow slate under his arm and its writing to his sleeve, the box locked and Silt's fourth true subtraction inside, believing he has done a kindness; the key went up in a coat pocket that never comes back down and there is no key under any roof. **Four readings of the year now stand behind one unsigned figure** — four are four and not one account; the first is not made a thirteenth by the three that follow, the second supplies no signature, the third no doctrine, the fourth no payer; the twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 are not laid across the four to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer; the figure read is still not the figure paid. Hessa goes up the clay road before noon with the narrow slate held edge-on to her forearm and the writing turned to her sleeve, hand to slate before eye to crowd, giving no figure and not made a reader by four figures; the reported second slate of Silt 6 stays a shape in a mouth on a place of its own, is not brought on stage, is not hers to read and is given no figure. The bell goes four, four and a gap through the market and nobody crosses himself; the told bell stands beside the heard bell with both gaps in their own squares and three counts in three places staying three (T078, T061/T082). Answer 443 is filed on the sixth place; count reaches 434 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-four days, told by nobody (T071/T072).

scenes.title: What the Tenth Left
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the Silt 10 market after the reading, the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 444 filed and the count at 434 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-four days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Berr gone up the clay road with the box locked and the fourth subtraction inside; Hessa up the road with the narrow slate unread and her eighth record-first hand eight; Tarn and Jorra offstage at kindling and wheel-shed; Ilva offstage with the strip in wood and her ninth hand nine; the soft-cuffed clerk reported at the landing; the offered figure, the well-asking, the second man's slate and direction, the clerk's entered figure, the fifth shaping, the three likenesses of Slate Row, the neighbour's near-reaching, the reported second slate, the hair-thin thaw, the burned slate at five and the four ownerless directions each on a place of its own with a finger between every pair. Walk-ons only at the market and yard grammar; no green or shape promoted to an eighth, no name spoken over either, the two Ilmen 30 sightings left unspent on their separate trays. Dramatic purpose: the market sells over the reading the way water goes over a stone; eight pigs go over the wet boards, figures are brought to a heap of turnips and left standing side by side without being made to agree, a number in a fist goes toward a slate at the watch and arrives nowhere, a woman sent for a pot's cost gets a note and not a price, and the dressed grain covered at home does not know what it cost, with the ink-neat space unsigned (T077). The boy takes the half-beat at the setting apart by fist and eye and mouth and gives the gap no intention; the surgeon reads a hand arriving at two inches of air and stopping, and the infant wants that hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither buying the other (T060/T086/T097, T061/T082). Sella carries him home at the going of the light saying nothing and sets the basket in the moot-post's shade again at the reading and stands half a pace off; under the roof the whole grammar returns — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on the shelf's top with the charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand shut half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing between older brass staple and tighter wire and both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, repair held apart from restoration, grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the fold righted without a look at his face and no second fold, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding (T058/T079/T100, T097). The widow's mark hangs where it hangs — a morning, a shelf, a pot, a yard, a market, a reading, a basket, a bed and a going of the light are not openings, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule, and an Account-day does not make an eighth come due. Small hours: the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments do when a case is done; six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside; the heard bell stands beside the told bell with both gaps in their own squares and three counts in three places staying three; nine record-first hands and nine stoppings stand with no tenth; seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule; **four readings of the year stand behind one unsigned figure, four being four and not one account, the twelve not laid across the four, no signature in any, no doctrine out of four, the figure read still not the figure paid** — and Berr's kindness and *your house*, the Kindling collector's reason, the clean voice's missing name and the Long Night story's empty name go on gathering toward the far-off accounting and are not paid (T015/T041/T047, T080/T090, T065/T095). Tarn's valuable ear stands more exposed in a term already ended with the loan uncalled, Jorra's promise stands ungiven against the burned slate at five, and the unsent call to Nina stays where it was put and is not paid again (T036/T076/T006, T035/T031/T062, T020 held). Answer 444 is filed; six honest answers 439 through 444 stand on the sixth place, two to each of the three days, and not one is a doctrine. Count 434 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-four days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth is unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the man and the fire standing side by side without becoming one, and he stands no number up as a threshold, doctrine or figure, for a number counted is a number with air around it and air buys no warmth (T071/T072, T088). Through the finger's-width door the river keeps its low note of water over water under its winter skin, softer at one edge; the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward it — the inch not a reach, not a wanting made into a claim, only the body's small assent to a sound — takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go as the note ends, and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. There is no next hand in the room. He does not wipe the thread and does not lift the crust. Four low pulls breathe under the floor and the fifth is not supplied. Forward, into an eleventh day not yet lived and not brought into this one.
